notes.title: Subject: Relictus v0.6.3.0 update
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects for the Feral Root
[*] Added a defeat animation for Mantle Destroyer
[*] Added a defeat animation for the Kushtaka
[*] Added an unlockable ultimate ability for Devognya: Hades Burst - Consume 40% health to cause a massive explosion at the subject’s location
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the text on the Crystal Infuser (the crafting table thing) to “Take Crystal Capacitor”
[*] The Golden Orb is much less likely to spawn progression items (orange)
[*] Made several edits to the Feral Root’s attacks:
 	[list]
[*] It’s nettle attack now phases through walls
[*] The nettle attack now also shoots more nettles on average
[*] Feral Root attacks more often in general
[*] The feral fumers now only last 15 seconds
[/list]
[*] Increased Muck’s bullet spread to 12 (from 6) to make him less of a sharpshooter and also to make him rely a little more on his passive and active abilities
[*] Increased Muck’s magnetism radius to 4 meters (from 3)
[*] HolGil no longer triggers the screenshake
[*] Fixed Creation Clay only adding extra charges if you have 0 consumables
[*] Reworked the progression item spawns in Crystalline Flats; enemies will now instead have a chance to drop the currently required item for the Crystal Infuser. So enemies will only drop Lectrinium Wire (when the item rolls as orange) until you place the wire on the infuser and then they will only drop Insulated Pyllarite
[*] Placing the parts on the Crystal Infuser now removes that item from the Subject’s inventory
[*] Crystal Capacitors are now added to the drop pool after the first capacitor has been crafted
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: Subject: Relictus v0.6.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[u][h3]Additions[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] The Kushtaka no longer uses Mantle Destroyer’s health bar and has it’s own custom bar
[*] Added a new unlockable ultimate ability for Subject: Muck - Celestial Body, unlockable via the ‘Smashing!’ achievement
[*] Added custom crosshairs for all subjects
[*] Added a new attack/function for the Crystalline Contraption: Overheat - If the Contraption uses too many attacks in a short succession, it will overheat and have to open up it’s core then spray itself with two cryo blasts which may harm the subject if too close.
[/list]
[u][h3]Fixes[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Increased the base chance for Holographics Card to trigger to 10% (From 6%)
[*] Fixed Kushtaka’s teleportation attack crashing the game
[/list]

notes.title: Subject: Relictus v0.6.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[u]Additions[/u]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects for Scorch Beetles
[*] Added sound effects for Burohs
[*] Added ability descriptions when you hover over them in the ability edit menu
[*] Reworked multiple aspects of the Crystalline Construct and it’s fight:
     [list]
      [*] Added sound effects to the Crystalline Construct
      [*] Added an extra effect to Crystalline Construct’s stomp attack
      [*] The Crystalline Construct’s movements and attacks are no longer specifically based on the player’s location and are now more randomized
      [*] Slight rework to Crystalline Construct’s Lectrinium Beam attack
      [*] Crystalline Construct’s Cubicine Spinner attack now covers a larger area
     [/list]
[*] Added an animation and sound effects to when the Crystalline Beacon is activated
[*] Added Subject descriptions/lore to the ability selection screen when hovering over the subject’s name
[/list]
[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Redrew the Crystalline Flats map layout to be more open and less… Vertical.
[/list]

notes.title: The Frostbound Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sounds effects to Volatile Moths and explosions
[*] Added sound effects for DR-1’s Hav0c Reaper Drone (The purple drone)
[*] Added a new consumable item: Suspicious Clock
[*] Added a new consumable item: Cracked Iozinite
[*] Added a new prototype item: Timespace Receiver
[*] Added a new rare item: Electromancy Manual
[*] Added a new common item: Cryomancy Manual
[*] Added a new legendary item: Heart-Shaped Box
[*] Added an ability selection screen to the subject selection menu
[*] Removed splitscreen due to its buggy nature :((
[*] Added an unlockable primary ability for DR-1: CNI Survey Drone - unlockable via ‘The Lazy Commander’ achievement
[*] Added an unlockable secondary ability for DR-1: M8-10NC Repair Drone - unlockable via the ‘Almost Human’ achievement
[*] Added an unlockable utility ability for Gil: Dislocator Construct - unlockable via the ‘Little Bit of Kick’ achievement
[*] Added a new stage: Polaris Peaks; a snowy permafrost at the top of Ato-Relictus’ highest mountains
[*] Added a new enemy to the spawn pool: Rhineram - the respective owner of those horns you keep getting who live in the Crystalline Flats, Molten Canyon, and Polaris Peaks stages.
[*] Added a new boss for the Polaris Peaks: The Kushtaka - A legendary creature and defender of the Glowing Moon, Relictus-Miko
[*] Added a new secret subject: Dr. Morena Phraust - Only accessible via Rime Golem’s ‘Bound by Science’
[*] Added Rime Golem's passive ability: Bound by Science - Upon death, Rime Golem will lose all his items, but maintain experience level and swap to a new subject: Morena Phraust.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the difficulty scalar of each difficulty. The game now increases difficulty a little slower and runs start off a little easier as well
[*] All items now drop 10% more often
[*] Added a visual effect for the geomancy manual
[*] Reworked some of the items that deal damage, like the tactical grenade launcher. Damage of such items now scale with player’s damage-enhancements
[*] Static Brick’s extra attack now applies the electro effect for 6 seconds
[*] Ancient Bark now properly heals ALL allies within the circle (It previously would heal the first ally to enter the circle)
[*] The camera now shakes when the player takes damage
[*] Buffed Eggnog’s regeneration to 0.5hp/sec (From 0.3hp/sec)
[*] Buffed Feral Fruit’s health increase to 20hp each (From 10hp)
[*] Buffed Lost Sole’s speed increase to 2% each (From 1% each)
[*] Leveling up now increases health by 20% of base hp and not 20 flat hp
[*] Tactical Grenade Launcher now also increases blast radius of grenades by 10% per launcher
[*] Redesigned the molten canyon map layout due to an error corrupting the original map file
[*] Reworked the lava in the Molten Canyon to be a little easier to escape
[*] Fixed Holo-Gil crashing the game when having on-kill items
[*] Cryo damage now deals 1 damage per second per stack
[*] Cryo damage will no longer inflict freeze and only slows victims down to a minimum of 0.2 speed
[*] Added a maximum particle count to avoid the game slowing down due to excessive particles
[*] Reduced the spawn cooldown range for enemies (Enemies will spawn approximately 20% more often)
[*] Burning Infection puddles are no longer permanent and only last 15 seconds
[/list]

[h1]New Map[/h1]
[u][h2]Polaris Peaks[/h2][/u]
[i]Spectral Doorway[/i]
A snowy permafrost atop Ato-Relictus’ highest mountains, when the rare Aurora Animus passes through is when the barrier between the spirit realm is the weakest.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/1a29956e28bc52e2c5ede926cd7b01d70c4684b3.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[u][h2]Cryomancy Manual[/h2][/u]
[i]Used for cold reads.[/i]
Rarity: Common
Attacks have a 10% chance to apply 1 stack of cryo for 2 seconds
[i](Additional Cryomancy Manuals add 2 seconds to the duration)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/9a86a77173c93157b5d3076442dbd49c18092035.gif[/img]

[u][h2]Electromancy Manual[/h2][/u]
[i]Lightning always strikes at the darkest times.[/i]
Rarity: Rare
Killing enemies has a 12% chance to strike a random enemy with lightning, affecting them with electro and dealing high damage
[i](Additional Electromancy Manuals strike an additional enemy)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/924efbc14bab22872e6867930173394f21211658.gif[/img]

[u][h2]Heart-Shaped Box[/h2][/u]
[i]You never know what you're gonna get.[/i]
Rarity: Legendary
Enemies drop truffles on kill that increase a random stat when picked up, buffs only last for the current stage
[i](Additional Heart-Shaped Boxes drop additional truffles)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/00ad40cee17d4f5932b05d4dbce8ab0367e60f62.gif[/img]

[u][h2]Suspicious Clock[/h2][/u]
[i]Forever Snooze[/i]
Rarity: Consumable
Drops a bomb with a 5 second fuse that creates a massive explosion, damaging ALL entities
[i](2 Charges)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/5fcab0792e2f3fe618ff96e8b210c7add79f2fda.gif[/img]

[u][h2]Cracked Iozinite[/h2][/u]
[i]It's unstable and dangerous[/i]
Rarity: Consumable
Release a shockwave that will launch all enemies around you in an upward direction
[i](2 Charges)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/7476fd3c2c6cfbcde06491ecc913b3614f36d4a3.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Embers Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW! SUBJECT: DEVOGNYA!
[*] Added a new map: Molten Canyon
[*] Added a new boss: The Mantle Destroyer
[*] Added a new map variation of the Arid Boneyard
[*] Added a new uncommon item: Pyromancy Manual
[*] Added a new uncommon item: Spring-Loaded Arm
[*] Added a new rare item: Scorched Elytra
[*] Added a new prototype item: Necromancy Manual
[*] Added a new prototype item: Shapeless Entity
[*] Added a new consumable item: Geomancy Manual
[*] Added a new consumable item: Anomalous Cube
[*] Added a new epic item: Essence of Rage
[*] Added a new epic item: QuickDraw Holster
[*] Added a new epic item: Burning Infection
[*] Added text on the screen that tells you how to summon the boss
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redisigned the sprite for Holographics Card
[*] Redisigned the sprite for Static Brick
[*] Realigned the cooldown bars for Rime Golem and DR-1 to no longer be off center
[*] Fixed the Rime Golem subject selection button locking players in as Rime Golem
[*] Made the crosshair a more vibrant red to be more noticable
[*] The 'freeze' status effect no longer affects bosses
[*] Fixed Breezeriders (the blue dwarves) not triggering on-kill effects when they die
[/list]

[h1]New Subject[/h1]
[h2][u]Subject: Devognya[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/1286363cfb6fb99bda32609841d0d16ae034719c.png[/img]
Devognya is hard-hitting, fire-based subject who can use her own health to deal high amounts of damage and set enemies aflame.

[h1]New Map[/h1]
[h2][u]Molten Canyon[/u][/h2]
[i]Fiery Gorge[/i]
A large hellish crack in the surface of Ato-Relictus, filled with eruptive and unstable lava pools, yet it still holds a diverse ecosystem and no one knows how or why.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/abaf86a0b04c58c85a19943d59cc9e97451a79fe.png[/img]


[h1]New Items[/h1]
[h2][u]Pyromancy Manual[/u][/h2]
[i]Pyromancy is a controversial subject.[/i]
Rarity: Uncommon
Creates 4 meter aura deals 3 pyro damage per second
[i](Collecting more does and additional 3 pyro damage per Pyromancy Manual)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/196e2d62d31074870f261edf61a779a33fc6894e.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Spring-Loaded Arm[/u][/h2]
[i]*Not a toy*[/i]
Rarity: Uncommon
Increases the knockback stat by 0.5
[i](Additional Spring-Loaded Arms increase knockback by 0.5 as well)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/e030334f016cf3e7a87680dbc878851f75d63fcf.gif[/img]
[i]*Sprite by Haley Taylor[/i]

[h2][u]Scorched Elytra[/u][/h2]
[i]It's hard shell can reach temperatures of up to 2,800 degrees[/i]
Rarity: Rare
6% chance on attack to shoot a fireball
[i](Additional Scorched Elytra add a 6% chance to shoot each)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/6b2fe82d6a0d496dfce7eec6251698476b329f12.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Essence of Rage[/u][/h2]
[i]Your pain fuels the mantle[/i]
Rarity: Epic
Taking damage has a 10% chance to create a mini eruption nearby
[i](Additional Essences of Rage add an additional 10% chance each)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/e0456147c86a39e006af6e689713ee7550f81141.gif[/img]
[i]*Sprite by Haley Taylor[/i]

[h2][u]QuickDraw Holster[/u][/h2]
[i]Have your weapons stored as data instantly![/i]
Rarity: Epic
Reduce consumable cooldown by 10%
[i](Additional QuickDraw Holsters reduce the consumable cooldown by an additional 10% each)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/16d76c37c81910c82c8b6af351242a54176525dc.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Burning Infection[/u][/h2]
[i]May your flesh boil and fester[/i]
Rarity: Epic
Killing Enemies makes them explode into fiery goo
[i](Additional Burning Infections causes enemies to explode into more goo)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/3b9200ceff8417cc00e4ca051d94c6640fee1900.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Anomalous Cube[/u][/h2]
[i]It's not a die, nor a puzzle...[/i]
Rarity: Consumable [i](4 Uses)[/i]
Upon use, trigger one of 5 effects:
[olist]
[*] Nothing
[*] Heal for 40% max hp
[*] Heal for 80% max hp
[*] Damage for 20% max hp
[*] Damage for 40% max hp
[/olist]
[i](Subjects cannot die from Anomalous Cube's effects)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/f9707616f834d212ecb4590a4fff3c60c5ca6645.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Geomancy Manual[/u][/h2]
[i]It advises you stay grounded[/i]
Rarity: Consumable [i](3 Uses)[/i]
Upon use, launch the subject upwards at double their jump height
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/c31849aa02013ddd2a346c29ca2adead4dcb7dc5.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Shapeless Entity[/u][/h2]
[i]Inconceivable!!![/i]
Rarity: Prototype
Grants infinite consumables, but each time you use it, your consumable item is randomized
[i](Collecting additional Shapeless Entities allows subjects to use consumables more than just once.)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/66d523b16ba4572ecdfe1b68046b26a8c1ff0be2.gif[/img]
*Sprite by Haley Taylor

[h2][u]Necromancy Manual[/u][/h2]
[i]Not to be confused with the Necronomicon.[/i]
Rarity: Prototype
Grants another life, and consumes 1 upon use. But each time you revive you have a permanent -10% health downgrade,
[i](Subjects cannot drop below 10hp from Necromancy Manual's health downs. Additional Necromancy Manuals grant additional lives.)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647139/60c147498f65795f236bc6e63b1fd79bbda35f9b.gif[/img]
